data.title: Tower Coverage Gaps
data.statement:
Along a straight road of length L (from position 0 to position L), N signal towers have been installed. Each tower i is placed at position P[i] and covers the road segment [P[i] − R[i], P[i] + R[i]], clipped to the road boundaries [0, L].

Towers can overlap, and some parts of the road may not be covered by any tower.

Compute the total length of the road that is NOT covered by any tower.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Along a straight road of length L (from position 0 to position L), N signal towers have been installed. Each tower i is placed at position P[i] and covers the road segment [P[i] − R[i], P[i] + R[i]], clipped to the road boundaries [0, L].

Towers can overlap, and some parts of the road may not be covered by any tower.

Compute the total length of the road that is NOT covered by any tower.
Input
Line 1: two integers L and N (road length, number of towers)
Next N lines: two integers P[i] and R[i] (tower position and radius)
Output
A single integer: the total uncovered length of the road.
Constraints
1 ≤ L ≤ 100000
0 ≤ N ≤ 1000
0 ≤ P[i] ≤ L
0 ≤ R[i] ≤ L
Example
Input
20 2
5 3
15 3
Output
8
